items.headline: Niemann’s LIV Korea Win
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf Korea with a birdie on the first playoff hole over Talor Gooch, marking his eighth LIV title and first of 2026.

items.headline: PGA Tour Overhaul Statement
items.text: PGA Tour CEO emphasized the plan to get top players competing more often, addressing long-standing challenges to revive fan interest.
